104	def run_report(spec_path: Path, out: Path) -> list[Claim]:
105	    specs, targets = load_report_spec(spec_path)
106	    scores = score_players(targets)
107	    curves = open_curve_runs(targets)
108	    claims = run_claims(scores, specs, charts=targets.crossplay, out=out)
109	    plot_curves(curves.ladder, scores=scores, baselines=targets.baselines, out=out / "ladder.png")
110	    plot_curves(curves.ablations, scores=scores, baselines=targets.baselines, out=out / "ablations.png")
111	    return claims
112	```

119	| # | Step | Owner | In → Out | Spine version | Covers |
120	|---|---|---|---|---|---|

122	| 2 | `pick_game` | lab.replay | RunRecord, game, new_seed, pair → GameRecording | the recorded game at index N; with `--pair`, one new game of those two generations (`lab.players.load_generation`, then PL-03 step 10 as built); with `--new`, PL-03 steps 1, 9 and 10 as built with `n_games=1, record=1` | REPLAY-01, REPLAY-03 |

133	<!-- docs/architecture.md:142 -->
134	### AD-09: A batch-first environment interface over agents, adopted before M1 is built
135	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `core`
136	- **Context:** CORE-01 now needs one interface for Snake (one agent, 3 discrete actions) and the fish tank (up to 16 fish, 2-D continuous actions). CORE-06 needs Snake and the corridor to behave as before. M1's plan is approved but no code exists yet.
137	- **Decision:** Every environment is batch-first over its agents. Observations are `(n_agents, *obs_shape)`, actions `(n_agents,)` discrete or `(n_agents, dim)` continuous, per `core.ActionSpace`. Rewards and per-agent `done` are `(n_agents,)`, and the game-level `terminated`/`truncated` stay booleans. Snake and the corridor are the `n_agents == 1` case. `core.Agent.act` takes and returns batches, and `core.Transition` carries per-agent arrays with an `active` mask. M1 adopts this interface before it is built: a Replan of its interface task, so Snake is never written against the old shape.
138	- **Alternatives:** A separate multi-agent protocol beside the single-agent one — two interfaces for `train`, `evaluate` and `replay` to handle, against CORE-07. Per-agent dicts (PettingZoo style) — flexible, but slow for 8 fish in NumPy and unneeded with a fixed agent count. Migrating after M1 is built — the honest "revise the core" lesson, at the cost of rewriting a finished milestone's core and agents.
139	- **Consequences:** AD-13 adds teams on top: each team is batch-first as above. Value learners and Snake baselines handle a batch of 1. CORE-06 is met by M1's golden cases passing on the new interface, with their expected values unchanged. `pipeline-design`, `test-planning` and `build-planning` revisit M1's types and plan before the build starts.
140	
141	<!-- docs/architecture.md:171 -->
142	### AD-13: Teams in the core, adopted before M1 is built
143	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `core`
144	- **Context:** CORE-01 now needs environments with two teams of different sizes and views: predator-prey's 1-agent predator (19 values) and 6-agent prey (18 values). AD-09's batch-first arrays assume one observation shape per environment. M1 is approved but not yet built.
145	- **Decision:** `core.Env` declares `teams: Mapping[str, TeamSpec]`. Observations, actions, rewards and `done` are maps from team name to AD-09's batch-first arrays. Single-team environments use one team, `core.SOLO` (`"agents"`). One `core.Agent` acts for one team, and `train` and `evaluate` take one agent per team. `info` carries `score:<team>` per team, plus `score` for the first. M1 adopts this before it's built: a Replan of its interface task.
146	- **Alternatives:** A separate two-team protocol beside `core.Env` — two code paths in `train`, `evaluate` and replay, against CORE-07. Padding both teams to one observation shape with a team flag — one array, but a policy would see the other team's padding, and the scripted players get fiddly. Adding teams after M1 — rewrites M1's loop and evaluation.
147	- **Consequences:** M1's Snake and corridor code addresses `SOLO`; its golden values don't change. M2's fish tank is also one team. S3 adds no second loop.
148

171	### core.Env: type
172	```python
173	class Env(Protocol):
174	    teams: Mapping[str, TeamSpec]
175	    board: Literal["grid", "tank"]
176	    def reset(self, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]: ...
177	    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult: ...
178	    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray: ...
179	```
180	- **Invariants:** teams, each batch-first (AD-09, AD-13): observations map each team name to float32 `(n_agents, *obs_shape)` from its `TeamSpec`, and `actions` maps each team to `(n_agents,)` int64 when discrete or `(n_agents, dim)` float32 when continuous. Single-team environments have one team, `"agents"` (`core.SOLO`). Entries for agents already done are ignored. `info` always holds `steps`, `score:<team>` for each team, and `score` for the first team. `frame()` is an int8 grid of cell codes (0 empty, 1 head, 2 body, 3 food or goal) when `board == "grid"`, and a `(K, 4)` float32 array of circles `(x, y, radius, kind)` when `board == "tank"`, with kinds 0 ball, 1 fish, 2 caught fish, 3 predator, 4 prey, 5 caught prey, 6 pellet (AD-12). The same seed and actions give the same results.
181	- **Errors:** `RuntimeError` if `step` is called after the game is over. `ValueError` for a missing team, an action of the wrong shape, outside the discrete range, or non-finite.
182	- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, reference, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Env/ · **Cases:** a recorded 20-step Snake game ending in a wall hit; a recorded 9-step corridor game reaching the goal; a recorded 30-step 8-fish tank game with 2 catches; a recorded 40-step predator-prey game with 1 catch and 2 pellets eaten
183	- **Used by:** envs (provider), train, evaluate, reference, lab; PL-01, PL-03, PL-04, PL-05, PL-06
184

186	### core.StepResult: type
187	`@dataclass(frozen=True) class StepResult: obs: dict[str, np.ndarray]; reward: dict[str, np.ndarray]; done: dict[str, np.ndarray]; terminated: bool; truncated: bool; info: dict[str, float]`
188	- **Invariants:** each map has one entry per team. `reward[team]` is `(n_agents,)` float32 and `done[team]` `(n_agents,)` bool, true while an agent is out (a collision, the goal, a catch, or a caught prey waiting to reappear). `terminated` means the game itself ended (every single-team agent done); `truncated` means a step cap or starvation ended the game first. At most one of the two is true. `info` holds `steps`, `score:<team>` per team and `score`.
189	- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, reference · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.StepResult/ · **Cases:** an ordinary step; eating food; a wall collision; starvation truncation; a tank step with one fish caught; the tank's 1,000-step truncation; a predator-prey step with a catch
190	- **Used by:** envs, train, evaluate, reference; PL-01, PL-03

200	### core.Agent: type
201	```python
202	class Agent(Protocol):
203	    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray: ...
204	    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None: ...
205	    def save(self, path: Path) -> None: ...
206	    def load(self, path: Path) -> None: ...
207	```
208	- **Invariants:** one agent acts for one team: `act` takes that team's `(n_agents, *obs_shape)` and returns one action per agent, shaped by the team's `ActionSpace`. `explore=False` never samples or takes a random action (AGENT-07): value learners take the best-valued action and policy learners the policy's mean. Players that don't learn make `learn` a no-op. `save` then `load` gives the same `act` outputs.

213	### core.RunSettings: type
214	```python
215	@dataclass(frozen=True)
216	class RunSettings:
217	    name: str; env: Literal["snake", "corridor", "tank", "predprey"]; view: Literal["compact", "grid", "index", "full", "limited"]
218	    agent: Literal["tabular", "dqn", "reinforce", "ppo", "random", "scripted", "reference"]; n_agents: int
219	    opponents: Mapping[str, Literal["learn", "scripted", "random"]]; self_play: Literal["none", "latest", "pool"]

For `predprey`, `view` is `limited`, `agent` is `ppo` or `reference`, and `opponents` names both teams (`predator`, `prey`): `learn` teams train with `agent`; `self_play` is `latest` or `pool` only when both learn (rung 2, rung 3), `none` otherwise; `generations` is 10 when any team learns, else 0; `pool_latest` defaults to 0.5 (SELF-03). 341	### envs.Snake: Snake game
342	```python
343	class Snake(Env):
344	    def __init__(self, *, view: Literal["compact", "grid"], rewards: Rewards = Rewards(), size: int = 10) -> None: ...
345	    def reset_to(self, body: Sequence[tuple[int, int]], heading: Literal["up", "right", "down", "left"], food: tuple[int, int]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, int]]: ...

420	### train.train: Training loop
421	`def train(make_env: Callable[[], Env], agents: Mapping[str, Agent], settings: RunSettings, *, root: Path = Path("runs")) -> RunRecord`
422	- **Invariants:** `agents` has one agent per team; the teams `settings.opponents` marks `learn` (or `SOLO` in a single-team run) are learners. Steps the environment for `settings.steps` steps, building one batch-first `Transition` per learning team and calling that team's `learn` after every step (CORE-07). With `settings.generations`, it saves each learner's generation every tenth of the run (SELF-04); with `self_play == "pool"`, each game's opponent for every learner comes from its `selfplay.OpponentPool` (SELF-03, AD-14). Curve points evaluate the first learning team against the run's fixed opposition. It evaluates every `eval_every` steps (including step 0) into a `CurvePoint`. It prints a progress line at least every 30 s (RUN-04). It saves each learner's checkpoint and 5 recorded evaluation games at the end. The same settings give the same curve (RUN-03). It knows nothing environment-specific (CORE-02).
423	- **Errors:** on `KeyboardInterrupt`, finishes the run `incomplete`, then re-raises

465	<!-- docs/architecture.md:99 -->
466	### AD-03: Own environment protocol, shaped like Gymnasium
467	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `core`
468	- **Context:** CORE-01 needs one interface for every environment. REF-01 needs the library agent to train on the same Snake. AGENT-06 keeps library code out of the lab's agents.
469	- **Decision:** `core.Env` is a small Protocol whose `reset(seed)` returns `(obs, info)` and whose `step(actions)` returns a `StepResult` with Gymnasium's fields (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info), plus `frame()` for replay. AD-09 sets their batch-first shape over agents. `reference` wraps one single-agent team of a `core.Env`, with every other team played by a frozen agent (AD-15), in a `gymnasium.Env` adapter.
470	- **Alternatives:** Subclass `gymnasium.Env` directly — no adapter, but every environment and the core then depend on Gymnasium. A bespoke interface unlike Gymnasium's — needs a bigger adapter and teaches a nonstandard shape.
471	- **Consequences:** Truncation (starvation or the step cap) and termination (a collision or a catch) stay separate, so learning targets bootstrap correctly on truncation. The adapter is checked with Stable-Baselines3's `check_env`.
472	
473	<!-- docs/architecture.md:121 -->
474	### AD-06: One folder per run; TOML settings in, plain files out
475	**Status:** Accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **Scope:** `runs`
476	- **Context:** RUN-01 needs a run fully described by its settings. RUN-02 needs settings, seed, curve, checkpoint and games saved. RUN-05 needs reloading. The interrupted-run edge case needs partial records kept.
477	- **Decision:** Settings are read from TOML into a frozen `core.RunSettings`. Each run writes `runs/<name>-s<seed>-<timestamp>/` holding `settings.json` (the resolved settings), `curve.csv`, `checkpoint.pt` or `checkpoint.npz`, `games.npz` and `status` (`running`, `complete` or `incomplete`). The curve is appended as the run goes. An interrupt marks the run `incomplete`.
478	- **Alternatives:** An experiment tracker such as MLflow or W&B — a server or account for a one-person lab. One SQLite file — harder to inspect by eye and to delete one run from.
479	- **Consequences:** A run is inspectable with any text editor and deleted by removing its folder. Nothing indexes runs, so reports name their run folders explicitly.

67	1. **Interfaces followed** (CR-09): no frozen type, signature or contract folder changed outside a Revise. Consumers use the declared types: no dict for a dataclass, no reaching into a provider's internals, no local redefinition. A stub is replaced only by the task it names; no cross-package import outside the contract; spine tests run on samples and doubles, not another step's code.
68	2. **Tests prove something:** each intent test asserts its TC case or acceptance bullet, loading expected values and tolerances from fixtures; none is assertion-free or weakened; Hypothesis runs the `ci` profile. Unit tests are specific, never computing the expected value with the code under test or testing only a mock. **Mutation check** (`.claude/agents/reviewer.md`): per acceptance bullet, the smallest change that should break it; a mutation no test catches is a finding.
69	3. **Correct to the spec:** each acceptance bullet truly met, not special-cased to the sample; the error paths the requirement names; seeding and determinism; numerical edge cases.
70	4. **Simple** (CR-11, CR-12, CR-42): no abstraction with one implementation outside the contract or an AD; no forwarding wrapper, one-method class, or class where a function does; no parameter, flag or config key every caller sets the same; no `try/except` that only re-raises or swallows, no checks the types already guarantee; no loop the library already provides. No near-copies within or across the phase's tasks: one concept is one function in its owner module (tests may repeat for readability). Each finding names the simpler form, with the same tests passing.
71	5. **Pipelines** (CR-10): entry functions read as their step tables (`dt layout`); step owners respected; spine baselines still selectable.
72	6. **The bar** (CR-07): diff this file, `pyproject.toml`, `scripts/` and `.claude/agents/` against the milestone's Base. Any loosening is Critical; new exceptions need an owner and expiry.
73	7. **Hidden and parallel risks:** where a real provider could act differently from its double; fixed output paths, global state, test-order dependence.
74	8. **The rest:** readability, security, performance where a QR sets a number; reused reference or probe code has its Caveats handled and fits the contract; `dt lint` clean, pre-build sections replaced by `dt layout` pointers.
75	
76	**Milestone exit**, over the whole diff, adds: the Scope's Exit holds; every Covers ID has a test; `check.sh full --exit` finds no stub; system tests use real providers; the same sample through a real provider and its double agrees; deferred requirements untouched; pip-audit ran.
77	
78	**Severity:** Critical: a frozen interface changed, a contract test pinning a transient state, a weakened test, an intent test that misses a mutation changing its TC's expected output, a wrong answer, a loosened bar, a security hole, lost data; it stops the build. Important: a consumer bypassing a type, any other surviving mutation, an unneeded abstraction, a duplicate across tasks. Suggestion and Nit: local. Findings go under the checkpoint block in `tasks/plan.md` (`dt finding`), each with a fix task or a reason.
79	
80	## Done
81	agent-skills `references/definition-of-done.md`, tailored once:
82	- **Correctness and Quality:** checked per task by the gate.
83	- **Integration and Documentation:** checked at each checkpoint.
84	- **The full list:** checked at milestone exit.
85	
86	## Exceptions
87	| ID | Rule | Path | Reason | Owner | Expires |
88	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
89	| EX-01 | CR-25 DEP002 | `numpy`, `torch`, `matplotlib`, `stable-baselines3`, `gymnasium` | M1 dependencies, declared before the code imports them | @connorott | M1 exit |
90	| EX-02 | CR-24 layers | `rllab.compare` → `rllab.viz` | `compare.run_claims` takes `charts: Sequence[viz.Chart]` (contract); the sibling layers forbid it (M1-T01 escalation) | @connorott | M1 exit |

4	# references/ (reference files from docs/references.md) and probes/ (probe scripts from

6	# nothing imports from them (CR-08).

1	# rllab — Contract
2	
3	**Package:** rllab · **Status:** Approved · **Last updated:** 2026-10-19 · **Architecture:** [../../architecture.md](../../architecture.md)
4	
5	## core
6	
7	### core.Env: type
8	```python
9	class Env(Protocol):
10	    teams: Mapping[str, TeamSpec]
11	    board: Literal["grid", "tank"]
12	    def reset(self, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]: ...
13	    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult: ...
14	    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray: ...
15	```
16	- **Invariants:** teams, each batch-first (AD-09, AD-13): observations map each team name to float32 `(n_agents, *obs_shape)` from its `TeamSpec`, and `actions` maps each team to `(n_agents,)` int64 when discrete or `(n_agents, dim)` float32 when continuous. Single-team environments have one team, `"agents"` (`core.SOLO`). Entries for agents already done are ignored. `info` always holds `steps`, `score:<team>` for each team, and `score` for the first team. `frame()` is an int8 grid of cell codes (0 empty, 1 head, 2 body, 3 food or goal) when `board == "grid"`, and a `(K, 4)` float32 array of circles `(x, y, radius, kind)` when `board == "tank"`, with kinds 0 ball, 1 fish, 2 caught fish, 3 predator, 4 prey, 5 caught prey, 6 pellet (AD-12). The same seed and actions give the same results.
17	- **Errors:** `RuntimeError` if `step` is called after the game is over. `ValueError` for a missing team, an action of the wrong shape, outside the discrete range, or non-finite.
18	- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, reference, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Env/ · **Cases:** a recorded 20-step Snake game ending in a wall hit; a recorded 9-step corridor game reaching the goal; a recorded 30-step 8-fish tank game with 2 catches; a recorded 40-step predator-prey game with 1 catch and 2 pellets eaten
19	- **Used by:** envs (provider), train, evaluate, reference, lab; PL-01, PL-03, PL-04, PL-05, PL-06
20	
21	### core.TeamSpec: type
22	`@dataclass(frozen=True) class TeamSpec: n_agents: int; obs_shape: tuple[int, ...]; actions: ActionSpace`
23	- **Invariants:** `n_agents ≥ 1`; `obs_shape` is per agent. A team's agents all share one view and one action space, so one `core.Agent` can act for the whole team.
24	- **Boundary:** agents, baselines, reference, train, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.TeamSpec/ · **Cases:** Snake's one compact-view agent; the tank's 8 full-view fish; predator-prey's predator (1 × 19) and prey (6 × 18) teams
25	- **Used by:** envs, agents, baselines, reference, train, lab; PL-01, PL-03
26	
27	### core.SOLO: Single-team name
28	`SOLO: str = "agents"`
29	- **Invariants:** the one team name every single-team environment uses (Snake, the corridor, the fish tank).
30	- **Boundary:** envs, train, evaluate, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.SOLO/ · **Cases:** the constant
31	- **Used by:** envs, train, evaluate, lab; PL-01, PL-03
32	
33	### core.ActionSpace: type
34	`@dataclass(frozen=True) class ActionSpace: kind: Literal["discrete", "continuous"]; n: int = 0; dim: int = 0`
35	- **Invariants:** discrete: `n ≥ 2` and `dim == 0`. Continuous: `dim ≥ 1`, `n == 0`, and the environment clips each action itself (FISH-02).
36	- **Boundary:** agents, baselines, reference, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.ActionSpace/ · **Cases:** Snake's 3 discrete actions; the tank's 2-D continuous swim vector
37	- **Used by:** envs, agents, baselines, reference, lab; PL-01, PL-03
38	
39	### core.StepResult: type
40	`@dataclass(frozen=True) class StepResult: obs: dict[str, np.ndarray]; reward: dict[str, np.ndarray]; done: dict[str, np.ndarray]; terminated: bool; truncated: bool; info: dict[str, float]`
41	- **Invariants:** each map has one entry per team. `reward[team]` is `(n_agents,)` float32 and `done[team]` `(n_agents,)` bool, true while an agent is out (a collision, the goal, a catch, or a caught prey waiting to reappear). `terminated` means the game itself ended (every single-team agent done); `truncated` means a step cap or starvation ended the game first. At most one of the two is true. `info` holds `steps`, `score:<team>` per team and `score`.
42	- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, reference · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.StepResult/ · **Cases:** an ordinary step; eating food; a wall collision; starvation truncation; a tank step with one fish caught; the tank's 1,000-step truncation; a predator-prey step with a catch
43	- **Used by:** envs, train, evaluate, reference; PL-01, PL-03
44	
45	### core.Transition: type
46	`@dataclass(frozen=True) class Transition: obs: np.ndarray; actions: np.ndarray; reward: np.ndarray; next_obs: np.ndarray; terminated: np.ndarray; active: np.ndarray; truncated: bool`
47	- **Invariants:** one `Transition` per learning team per step, every array batch-first over that team's agents. `active` marks agents that acted this step. `terminated` is true per agent only for that agent's real end (a collision, the corridor goal or a catch), never for truncation, so truncated steps still bootstrap.
48	- **Boundary:** agents, baselines · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Transition/ · **Cases:** a food step; a collision step; a truncated step; a tank step with 8 active fish of which one is caught
49	- **Used by:** train, agents, baselines; PL-01
50	
51	### core.Agent: type
52	```python
53	class Agent(Protocol):
54	    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray: ...
55	    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None: ...
56	    def save(self, path: Path) -> None: ...
57	    def load(self, path: Path) -> None: ...
58	```
59	- **Invariants:** one agent acts for one team: `act` takes that team's `(n_agents, *obs_shape)` and returns one action per agent, shaped by the team's `ActionSpace`. `explore=False` never samples or takes a random action (AGENT-07): value learners take the best-valued action and policy learners the policy's mean. Players that don't learn make `learn` a no-op. `save` then `load` gives the same `act` outputs.
60	- **Boundary:** train, evaluate, lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.Agent/ · **Cases:** a replay double recording 5 act/learn calls of a tabular agent
61	- **Used by:** agents, baselines, reference (providers); train, evaluate, lab; PL-01, PL-03, PL-04, PL-05
62	
63	### core.RunSettings: type
64	```python
65	@dataclass(frozen=True)
66	class RunSettings:
67	    name: str; env: Literal["snake", "corridor", "tank", "predprey"]; view: Literal["compact", "grid", "index", "full", "limited"]
68	    agent: Literal["tabular", "dqn", "reinforce", "ppo", "random", "scripted", "reference"]; n_agents: int
69	    opponents: Mapping[str, Literal["learn", "scripted", "random"]]; self_play: Literal["none", "latest", "pool"]
70	    pool_latest: float; generations: int
71	    ablation: Literal["none", "no_memory", "no_target", "no_explore"]
72	    rewards: Rewards; exploration: Exploration; params: AgentParams
73	    steps: int; seed: int; eval_every: int; eval_games: int
74	```
75	- **Invariants:** `seed` in `[0, 1_000_000)`. `steps` > 0. `view` belongs to `env` (Snake `compact`/`grid`, corridor `index`, tank `full`/`limited`). `n_agents` is 1 except for the tank (1–16, FISH-07). `reinforce` and `ppo` only with the tank; `tabular` and `dqn` only with Snake or the corridor. `reference` on the tank needs `n_agents == 1` and `full`. For `predprey`, `view` is `limited`, `agent` is `ppo` or `reference`, and `opponents` names both teams (`predator`, `prey`): `learn` teams train with `agent`; `self_play` is `latest` or `pool` only when both learn (rung 2, rung 3), `none` otherwise; `generations` is 10 when any team learns, else 0; `pool_latest` defaults to 0.5 (SELF-03). Single-team runs have `opponents == {}`. `ablation` matches `agent` (`no_memory` and `no_target` with `dqn`, `no_explore` with `tabular`).
76	- **Boundary:** lab, train, runs, reference · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/core.RunSettings/ · **Cases:** the dqn-compact ladder settings; a corridor tabular settings; a no_target ablation; the rung-3 tank settings (ppo, 8 fish, full view); the tank reference settings; predator-prey rung 1 (prey learn, scripted predator); rung 3 (both learn, pool)
77	- **Used by:** lab, train, runs, reference, agents; PL-01, PL-02, PL-03, PL-04, PL-06

106	### envs.Snake: Snake game
107	```python
108	class Snake(Env):
109	    def __init__(self, *, view: Literal["compact", "grid"], rewards: Rewards = Rewards(), size: int = 10) -> None: ...
110	    def reset_to(self, body: Sequence[tuple[int, int]], heading: Literal["up", "right", "down", "left"], food: tuple[int, int]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, int]]: ...
111	```
112	- **Invariants:** SNAKE-01–SNAKE-09. `reset_to` starts a game from a given board (cells are `(row, col)`, row 0 at the top, body head first), with score 0 and the step count at 0; later food is seeded as after `reset`. One team, `SOLO`, of 1 agent; `board == "grid"`. Actions: discrete 3, 0 straight, 1 turn left, 2 turn right. The compact observation has per-agent shape `(11,)`, laid out as `COMPACT_FIELDS`. The grid observation has per-agent shape `(3, size, size)`: head, body and food channels. Filling the board ends the game with `terminated=True` and no death reward.
113	- **Errors:** as `core.Env`; `reset_to` raises `ValueError` if the body is not contiguous, leaves the grid, or the food is on the snake
114	- **Boundary:** lab, reference, baselines · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/envs.Snake/ · **Cases:** a recorded compact-view game ending at a wall; a recorded grid-view game eating twice then hitting itself
115	- **Used by:** lab, reference, baselines; PL-01, PL-03

120	- **Errors:** as `core.Env`

153	### envs.PredatorPrey: Predator-prey world
154	```python
155	class PredatorPrey(Env):
156	    def __init__(self, *, rewards: Rewards = Rewards(food=1.0, death=-5.0, step=0.0)) -> None: ...
157	    def reset_to(self, predator: tuple[float, float], prey: Sequence[tuple[float, float]], pellets: Sequence[tuple[float, float]]) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]: ...
158	```
159	- **Invariants:** HUNT-01–HUNT-09, with the spec's numbers as module constants and the tank's vectorised physics (AD-16). Teams `"predator"` (1 agent, view `(19,)` as `PREDATOR_FIELDS`) and `"prey"` (6 agents, view `(18,)` as `PREY_FIELDS`), both continuous with `dim == 2`; `board == "tank"`. `rewards.food` is the prey's pellet reward and `rewards.death` its catch penalty; the predator earns +1 per catch. `info` holds `score:predator` (catches so far) and `score:prey` (mean reward per prey so far). The game only truncates, at step 1,000.
160	- **Errors:** as `core.Env`; `reset_to` raises `ValueError` for a position outside the tank, a count other than 6 prey or 8 pellets, or a prey within 0.4 of the predator
161	- **Boundary:** lab, reference, baselines, selfplay · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/envs.PredatorPrey/ · **Cases:** a recorded 40-step game with 1 catch and 2 pellets eaten; a recorded 60-step game where a caught prey reappears
162	- **Used by:** lab, reference, baselines, selfplay; PL-01, PL-03, PL-06

218	## agents
219	
220	### agents.TabularAgent: Table-based value learner
221	`class TabularAgent(Agent): def __init__(self, n_actions: int, params: AgentParams, exploration: Exploration, *, seed: int, explore_enabled: bool = True)`
222	- **Invariants:** single-agent (batches of 1). One value per (observation, action), keyed on the observation's bytes and starting at 0. Each `learn` moves the value toward `reward + gamma · max next value`, with no bootstrap when `terminated` (AGENT-01). `explore_enabled=False` is the `no_explore` ablation (ABL-03). The checkpoint is NPZ.
223	- **Boundary:** lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.TabularAgent/ · **Cases:** a replay double of 5 act/learn calls on the corridor
224	- **Used by:** lab; PL-01, PL-03
225	
226	### agents.DQNAgent: Neural value learner
227	`class DQNAgent(Agent): def __init__(self, team: TeamSpec, params: AgentParams, exploration: Exploration, *, seed: int, ablation: Literal["none", "no_memory", "no_target"] = "none")`
228	- **Invariants:** single-agent (batches of 1). The network's input is `team.obs_shape` and its outputs `team.actions.n`. AGENT-03–AGENT-05 and AD-05. With `ablation="no_memory"`, each update uses only the latest transition (ABL-01). With `ablation="no_target"`, targets come from the online network (ABL-02). `ablation` takes `RunSettings.ablation`'s DQN values. No updates happen before `learn_start` transitions. The checkpoint is a PyTorch state dict.
229	- **Errors:** `ValueError` if `team.n_agents != 1`, `team.actions.kind != "discrete"`, or `net="cnn"` and `team.obs_shape` is not 3-D
230	- **Boundary:** lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.DQNAgent/ · **Cases:** a replay double of 5 act/learn calls on the compact view after `learn_start`
231	- **Used by:** lab; PL-01, PL-03
232	
233	### agents.ReinforceAgent: Plain policy-gradient learner
234	`class ReinforceAgent(Agent): def __init__(self, obs_shape: tuple[int, ...], actions: ActionSpace, params: AgentParams, *, seed: int)`
235	- **Invariants:** PG-01, PG-02, AD-11. Collects whole games, and after `games_per_update` of them takes one gradient step on the return-to-go, normalised within the batch. `act(explore=True)` samples the Gaussian; `explore=False` returns its mean. The checkpoint is a PyTorch state dict.
236	- **Errors:** `ValueError` unless `actions.kind == "continuous"`
237	- **Boundary:** lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.ReinforceAgent/ · **Cases:** a replay double of one 3-game update on one fish
238	- **Used by:** lab; PL-01, PL-03
239	
240	### agents.PPOAgent: Clipped policy-gradient learner
241	`class PPOAgent(Agent): def __init__(self, obs_shape: tuple[int, ...], actions: ActionSpace, params: AgentParams, *, seed: int)`
242	- **Invariants:** PG-01, PG-03, PG-04, AD-11. One shared policy and value network acts for every active agent. After `rollout_steps` agent-steps it computes advantages (GAE with `gae_lambda`), then runs `epochs` passes of minibatches of `batch_size` on the clipped objective. Inactive agents' steps never enter a batch. The checkpoint is a PyTorch state dict.
243	- **Errors:** `ValueError` unless `actions.kind == "continuous"`
244	- **Boundary:** lab · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.PPOAgent/ · **Cases:** a replay double of one 64-step rollout and update on 8 fish
245	- **Used by:** lab; PL-01, PL-03
246	
247	### agents.returns_to_go: Discounted returns-to-go
248	`def returns_to_go(rewards: np.ndarray, gamma: float) -> np.ndarray`
249	- **Invariants:** `G_t = r_t + gamma · G_{t+1}` within one game, with `G` after the last step 0; output has the input's length, float64 (PG-02).
250	- **Errors:** `ValueError` unless `0 < gamma ≤ 1` and `rewards` is 1-D
251	- **Boundary:** agents · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.returns_to_go/ · **Cases:** a 3-step game
252	- **Used by:** agents (ReinforceAgent); PL-01
253	
254	### agents.gae: Generalised advantage estimates
255	`def gae(rewards: np.ndarray, values: np.ndarray, terminated: np.ndarray, gamma: float, lam: float) -> np.ndarray`
256	- **Invariants:** `δ_t = r_t + gamma · V(s_{t+1}) · (1 − terminated_t) − V(s_t)`, `A_t = δ_t + gamma · lam · (1 − terminated_t) · A_{t+1}`; `values` has one more entry than `rewards` (the bootstrap value after the last step); output float64 of the rewards' length (PG-03).
257	- **Errors:** `ValueError` if the lengths don't match or `lam` is outside `[0, 1]`
258	- **Boundary:** agents · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.gae/ · **Cases:** a 2-step rollout ending in a catch; a 3-step truncated rollout
259	- **Used by:** agents (PPOAgent); PL-01
260	
261	### agents.clipped_objective: Clipped surrogate objective
262	`def clipped_objective(ratio: np.ndarray, advantage: np.ndarray, clip: float) -> np.ndarray`
263	- **Invariants:** elementwise `min(ratio · advantage, clip(ratio, 1 − clip, 1 + clip) · advantage)`, the quantity PPO maximises (PG-03); works on NumPy arrays, and the agent applies the same formula to tensors.
264	- **Errors:** `ValueError` unless `0 < clip < 1` and the shapes match
265	- **Boundary:** agents · **Fixtures:** tests/contracts/agents.clipped_objective/ · **Cases:** four (ratio, advantage) pairs straddling the clip
266	- **Used by:** agents (PPOAgent); PL-01

Steps the environment for `settings.steps` steps, building one batch-first `Transition` per learning team and calling that team's `learn` after every step (CORE-07). With `settings.generations`, it saves each learner's generation every tenth of the run (SELF-04); with `self_play == "pool"`, each game's opponent for every learner comes from its `selfplay.OpponentPool` (SELF-03, AD-14). Curve points evaluate the first learning team against the run's fixed opposition. It evaluates every `eval_every` steps (including step 0) into a `CurvePoint`. It prints a progress line at least every 30 s (RUN-04). It saves each learner's checkpoint and 5 recorded evaluation games at the end. The same settings give the same curve (RUN-03). It knows nothing environment-specific (CORE-02).

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# One entry point for every quality check. Hooks call it; so do CI and people.
3	# Written by dev-team2 build-setup. Change it through build-setup (Revise), not by hand:
4	# CONSTRAINTS.md names the rule each step enforces.
5	#
6	#   scripts/check.sh fast FILE...        per edit, instant               (PostToolUse: tester, implementer)
7	#   scripts/check.sh collect             tester's finish gate            (Stop: tester)
8	#   scripts/check.sh gate [--pkg ID]     implementer's finish gate       (Stop: implementer and solo; dt land)
9	#   scripts/check.sh full [--pkg ID]     checkpoints, CI                 (reviewer)
10	#   scripts/check.sh full --exit         the milestone exit: also no interface stub left
11	#   scripts/check.sh protected           print the protected-path globs  (path_guard.sh deny --protected)
12	#
13	# The base is refs/worktree/checks-base, one per worktree (dt claim sets it in a builder's worktree,
14	# dt land in the main checkout), else HEAD.
15	#
16	# tests/contracts/** in the protected list means the boundary contracts frozen at the base (CR-09);
17	# a contract folder new since the base belongs to the interface task freezing it, which may write it,
18	# and so does a frozen folder the task's .claude/.task_writes names (a re-freeze interface task).
19	#
20	# collect runs the intent tests changed since the base and fails unless they are red for the right
21	# reason (scripts/red_check.py): AssertionError or an interface stub's NotImplementedError, never
22	# an ImportError or AttributeError.
23	#
24	# --pkg ID runs the tests of package ID and of every package that depends on it (multi-package:
25	# deptry too); gate and full also run tests/contracts, whole, when it exists. Lint, types, size
26	# and boundaries always cover the whole repo; they take seconds.
27	# FILE paths are absolute or relative to the project root.
28	# Prints every failure (it does not stop at the first) and exits 1 if any step failed.

30	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1   # hooks may run from another directory

36	PROTECTED=('tests/intent/**' 'tests/fixtures/**' 'tests/conftest.py' 'pyproject.toml' 'uv.lock' 'CONSTRAINTS.md' 'scripts/**' '.claude/agents/**' '.claude/settings.json' 'references/**' 'probes/**' 'tests/contracts/**')

127	# folder the task's .claude/.task_writes names (from its Writes:, by dt claim) is a re-freeze
128	# interface task's, so it is open to that task; dt land checks the Writes: against the plan.

152	protected_globs() {

159	# Fail if anything matching the given pathspecs changed since the base, untracked files included.
160	unchanged_since_base() {
161	  local label="$1" base new

164	  if ! base=$(base_commit); then

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Diff-scoped floor checks for CONSTRAINTS.md (CR-01 to CR-04, CR-07, CR-08).
3	
4	Called by scripts/floor_guard.sh, which writes the diff, the untracked-file list and the
5	base commit's pyproject.toml. Prints one line per finding and exits 1 if there are any:
6	
7	    path:line: [rule] message
8	
9	Rules (CONSTRAINTS.md ID in brackets):
10	    suppression [CR-01]            a new `type: ignore`, `pyright:`, `noqa`, `pragma: no cover`...
11	    stub [CR-02]                   a function whose body is only pass, ... or NotImplementedError
12	    stub-task [CR-02]              an interface stub, `raise NotImplementedError("M1-T05")`, naming
13	                                   a task that is not open in tasks/todo.md (whole repo, not the diff)
14	    stub-left [CR-02]              any interface stub, with --exit (the milestone exit)
15	    stub-pinned [CR-02]            a test naming NotImplementedError: it would pin a stub that a
16	                                   later task replaces, so no implementer could pass it
17	    swallowed-exception [CR-02]    `except:` / `except Exception:` with only pass
18	    test-skipped [CR-03]           a new skip, skipif, xfail or importorskip
19	    test-deleted [CR-03]           a test file removed
20	    assertion-removed [CR-03]      a test file lost more assertion lines than it gained
21	    test-without-assertion [CR-03] a changed test function that asserts nothing
22	    secret [CR-04]                 a credential pattern (the value is never printed)
23	    references-import [CR-08]      an import from the references folder
24	    references-path [CR-08]        the references folder put on an import path (sys.path,
25	                                   an environment variable, pytest or type-checker config)
26	    probes-import, probes-path     the same for the probes folder [CR-08]
27	    bar-loosened [CR-07]           pyproject.toml tool config weakened, or a new config file
28	    rule-removed [CR-07]           a CR rule gone from CONSTRAINTS.md
29	    new-exception [CR-07]          a new row in CONSTRAINTS.md's Exceptions table
30	
31	An interface stub is the one placeholder body CR-02 allows: the milestone's interface task writes
32	each step signature that way, naming the task that replaces it, and testers import it before the
33	code exists. It is never a `stub` finding; `stub-task` and `stub-left` judge it instead.
34	
35	A CR-01 to CR-03 or CR-08 finding is allowed when an unexpired row in CONSTRAINTS.md's
36	Exceptions table names that rule and a path glob matching the file. Secrets and CR-07 never are.
37	Files under scripts/ are skipped for code checks: they are the bar, protected separately.
38	Files under references/ and probes/ are inputs, not project code: only the secret check reads them.

108	class Finding(NamedTuple):

119	@dataclass
120	class Diff:
121	    added: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str]]] = field(default_factory=dict)
122	    removed: dict[str, list[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
123	    deleted: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
124

129	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- the diff
130	HUNK = re.compile(r"^@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,\d+)? @@")
131	
132	
133	def _diff_path(raw: str) -> str:
134	    raw = raw.rstrip("\t")
135	    return raw[2:] if raw[:2] in {"a/", "b/"} else raw
136	
137	
138	def parse_diff(text: str) -> Diff:
139	    """Added lines (with new line numbers), removed lines and deleted files, per file."""
140	    diff = Diff()
141	    old = new = ""
142	    line_no = 0
143	    in_header = False
144	    for line in text.splitlines():
145	        if line.startswith("diff --git "):
146	            old, new, in_header = "", "", True
147	        elif in_header and line.startswith("--- "):
148	            old = _diff_path(line[4:])
149	        elif in_header and line.startswith("+++ "):
150	            new = _diff_path(line[4:])
151	            if new == "/dev/null":
152	                diff.deleted.add(old)
153	        elif match := HUNK.match(line):
154	            in_header, line_no = False, int(match[1])
155	        elif in_header:
156	            continue
157	        elif line.startswith("+"):
158	            diff.added.setdefault(new, []).append((line_no, line[1:]))
159	            line_no += 1
160	        elif line.startswith("-"):
161	            diff.removed.setdefault(old, []).append(line[1:])
162	    return diff

165	def add_untracked(diff: Diff, paths: list[str]) -> None:
166	    """An untracked file is all added lines."""
167	    for name in paths:
168	        path = Path(name)
169	        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 2_000_000:
170	            continue
171	        try:
172	            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
173	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
174	            continue
175	        diff.added[name] = list(enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1))

184	    if path.startswith("scripts/") or is_outside(path):
185	        return False
186	    return path.endswith((".py", ".pyi"))

190	    parts = Path(path).parts
191	    name = parts[-1] if parts else ""
192	    return (

194	        and (name.startswith("test_") or name.endswith("_test.py"))

199	def line_findings(diff: Diff) -> list[Finding]:
200	    found: list[Finding] = []
201	    for path, lines in diff.added.items():
202	        python, test = is_python(path), is_test_file(path)
203	        path_settings = not is_outside(path) and not path.endswith(DOC_SUFFIXES)
204	        for n, text in lines:
205	            if python and SUPPRESSION.search(text):
206	                found.append(Finding("suppression", path, n, "new suppression comment"))
207	            if path_settings and IMPORT_PATH_SETTING.search(text):
208	                found += [
209	                    Finding(f"{folder}-path", path, n, f"{folder}/ on an import path")
210	                    for folder, word in OUTSIDE.items()
211	                    if word.search(text)
212	                ]
213	            if test and SKIP.search(text):
214	                found.append(Finding("test-skipped", path, n, "test skipped or marked xfail"))
215	            if Path(path).name not in LOCKFILES:
216	                found += [
217	                    Finding("secret", path, n, f"looks like a {kind} (value not shown)")
218	                    for kind, pattern in SECRETS.items()
219	                    if pattern.search(text)
220	                ]
221	    return found

224	def test_file_findings(diff: Diff) -> list[Finding]:
225	    found = [
226	        Finding("test-deleted", p, 0, "test file deleted") for p in diff.deleted if is_test_file(p)
227	    ]
228	    for path, lines in diff.removed.items():
229	        if not is_test_file(path) or path in diff.deleted:
230	            continue
231	        lost = sum(bool(ASSERTION.search(t)) for t in lines)
232	        gained = sum(bool(ASSERTION.search(t)) for _, t in diff.added.get(path, []))
233	        if lost > gained:
234	            found.append(
235	                Finding("assertion-removed", path, 0, f"{lost - gained} assertion line(s) removed")
236	            )
237	    return found

241	def _touches(node: ast.AST, lines: set[int]) -> bool:
242	    start = getattr(node, "lineno", 0)
243	    end = getattr(node, "end_lineno", start) or start
244	    return any(start <= n <= end for n in lines)

247	def _is_trivial(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> bool:
248	    """Only pass, `...` or `raise NotImplementedError`, after an optional docstring."""
249	    stmts = body[1:] if body and _is_docstring(body[0]) else body
250	    return all(_is_placeholder(s) for s in stmts)

253	def _task_stub(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> str | None:
254	    """The task an interface stub names: a body that is only `raise NotImplementedError("M1-T05")`."""
255	    stmts = body[1:] if body and _is_docstring(body[0]) else body
256	    if len(stmts) != 1 or not isinstance(stmts[0], ast.Raise):
257	        return None
258	    exc = stmts[0].exc
259	    if not (isinstance(exc, ast.Call) and _name(exc.func) == "NotImplementedError"):
260	        return None
261	    arg = exc.args[0] if len(exc.args) == 1 and not exc.keywords else None
262	    if (
263	        isinstance(arg, ast.Constant)
264	        and isinstance(arg.value, str)
265	        and TASK_ID.fullmatch(arg.value)
266	    ):
267	        return arg.value
268	    return None
269	
270	
271	def _is_docstring(stmt: ast.stmt) -> bool:
272	    return (
273	        isinstance(stmt, ast.Expr)
274	        and isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Constant)
275	        and isinstance(stmt.value.value, str)
276	    )

278	
279	def _is_placeholder(stmt: ast.stmt) -> bool:
280	    if isinstance(stmt, ast.Pass):
281	        return True
282	    if isinstance(stmt, ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Constant):
283	        return stmt.value.value is Ellipsis
284	    if isinstance(stmt, ast.Raise) and stmt.exc is not None:
285	        exc = stmt.exc.func if isinstance(stmt.exc, ast.Call) else stmt.exc
286	        return _name(exc) == "NotImplementedError"
287	    return False

290	def _name(node: ast.AST) -> str | None:
291	    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
292	        return node.id
293	    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
294	        return node.attr
295	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
296	        return _name(node.func)
297	    return None

300	def _exempt_functions(tree: ast.Module) -> set[ast.AST]:
301	    """Abstract methods, overloads and Protocol members may have placeholder bodies."""
302	    exempt: set[ast.AST] = set()
303	    for node in ast.walk(tree):
304	        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
305	            if {_name(d) for d in node.decorator_list} & EXEMPT_DECORATORS:
306	                exempt.add(node)
307	        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and "Protocol" in {_name(b) for b in node.bases}:
308	            exempt.update(
309	                n for n in node.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
310	            )
311	    return exempt

314	def _in_folder(name: str | None, folder: str) -> bool:
315	    return name is not None and (name == folder or name.startswith(f"{folder}."))
316	
317	
318	def _mentions(node: ast.AST, word: re.Pattern[str]) -> bool:
319	    return any(
320	        isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value, str) and word.search(n.value)
321	        for n in ast.walk(node)
322	    )
323	
324	
325	def _is_sys_path(node: ast.AST) -> bool:
326	    return (
327	        isinstance(node, ast.Attribute)
328	        and node.attr == "path"
329	        and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name)
330	        and node.value.id == "sys"
331	    )
332

334	def _imported_modules(node: ast.AST) -> list[str | None]:
335	    """Absolute module names an import statement or an import_module call brings in."""
336	    if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
337	        return [alias.name for alias in node.names]
338	    if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
339	        return [node.module] if node.level == 0 else []
340	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and _name(node.func) in {"import_module", "__import__"}:
341	        first = node.args[0] if node.args else None
342	        if isinstance(first, ast.Constant) and isinstance(first.value, str):
343	            return [first.value]
344	    return []

347	def _changes_sys_path(node: ast.AST) -> bool:
348	    """sys.path.insert/append/extend, site.addsitedir, or an assignment to sys.path."""
349	    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute):
350	        func = node.func
351	        return func.attr == "addsitedir" or (
352	            func.attr in SYS_PATH_CALLS and _is_sys_path(func.value)
353	        )
354	    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
355	        return any(_is_sys_path(target) for target in node.targets)
356	    if isinstance(node, ast.AugAssign):
357	        return _is_sys_path(node.target)
358	    return False

361	def _outside_finding(path: str, node: ast.AST) -> Finding | None:
362	    """CR-08: an import from references/ or probes/, or either folder added to sys.path."""
363	    line = getattr(node, "lineno", 0)
364	    for folder, word in OUTSIDE.items():
365	        if any(_in_folder(name, folder) for name in _imported_modules(node)):
366	            return Finding(f"{folder}-import", path, line, f"import from {folder}/")
367	        if _changes_sys_path(node) and _mentions(node, word):
368	            return Finding(f"{folder}-path", path, line, f"{folder}/ added to sys.path")
369	    return None

372	def _asserts(func: ast.AST) -> bool:
373	    for node in ast.walk(func):
374	        if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
375	            return True
376	        name = _name(node) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) else None
377	        if name and (
378	            name.startswith("assert") or name in {"raises", "warns", "deprecated_call", "fail"}
379	        ):
380	            return True
381	    return False

384	def _stub_pinned(path: str, node: ast.AST, test: bool) -> list[Finding]:
385	    """A test naming NotImplementedError: it passes only while a stub stands (CR-02)."""
386	    if not test or isinstance(node, ast.Call) or _name(node) != "NotImplementedError":
387	        return []
388	    message = "a test expects NotImplementedError: check the signature, not the stub body"
389	    return [Finding("stub-pinned", path, getattr(node, "lineno", 0), message)]

392	def ast_findings(path: str, lines: set[int]) -> list[Finding]:
393	    try:
394	        tree = ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
395	    except (SyntaxError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
396	        return []  # ruff reports syntax errors; a deleted file has nothing to check
397	    exempt, test = _exempt_functions(tree), is_test_file(path)
398	    found: list[Finding] = []
399	    for node in ast.walk(tree):
400	        if not _touches(node, lines):
401	            continue
402	        if outside := _outside_finding(path, node):
403	            found.append(outside)
404	        found += _stub_pinned(path, node, test)
405	        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
406	            if (
407	                node not in exempt
408	                and not path.endswith(".pyi")
409	                and _is_trivial(node.body)
410	                and not _task_stub(node.body)
411	            ):
412	                found.append(
413	                    Finding("stub", path, node.lineno, f"`{node.name}` has a placeholder body")
414	                )
415	            if test and node.name.startswith("test") and not _asserts(node):
416	                found.append(
417	                    Finding(
418	                        "test-without-assertion",
419	                        path,
420	                        node.lineno,
421	                        f"`{node.name}` asserts nothing",
422	                    )
423	                )
424	        elif isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler) and _is_trivial(node.body):
425	            if (None if node.type is None else _name(node.type)) in TRIVIAL_EXCEPT:
426	                found.append(
427	                    Finding("swallowed-exception", path, node.lineno, "exception swallowed")
428	                )
429	    return found

432	def open_tasks() -> set[str]:
433	    """Task IDs with an unchecked line in tasks/todo.md (none when there is no todo)."""
434	    path = Path("tasks/todo.md")
435	    return set(OPEN_TASK.findall(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))) if path.is_file() else set()

438	def task_stub_findings(paths: list[str], at_exit: bool) -> list[Finding]:
439	    """Interface stubs anywhere in the project's code: each must name an open task, and at the
440	    milestone exit none may be left. Not diff-scoped: the stub was written by an earlier task."""
441	    open_ids, found = open_tasks(), []
442	    for path in paths:
443	        if not is_python(path) or is_test_file(path) or not Path(path).is_file():
444	            continue
445	        try:
446	            tree = ast.parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
447	        except (SyntaxError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
448	            continue
449	        for node in ast.walk(tree):
450	            if not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
451	                continue
452	            if not (task := _task_stub(node.body)):
453	                continue
454	            if at_exit:
455	                found.append(
456	                    Finding(
457	                        "stub-left",
458	                        path,
459	                        node.lineno,
460	                        f"`{node.name}` is still the stub for {task}",
461	                    )
462	                )
463	            elif task not in open_ids:
464	                found.append(
465	                    Finding(
466	                        "stub-task",
467	                        path,
468	                        node.lineno,
469	                        f"`{node.name}` is a stub naming {task}, which is not open in tasks/todo.md",
470	                    )
471	                )
472	    return found
473	
474	
475	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bar: tool config
476	MAX_KEYS = (
477	    "tool.ruff.lint.mccabe.max-complexity",
478	    "tool.size_limits.max_module_lines",
479	    "tool.size_limits.max_function_lines",
480	    "tool.vulture.min_confidence",
481	    "tool.pylint.similarities.min-similarity-lines",
482	)
483	MIN_KEYS = ("tool.coverage.report.fail_under", "tool.size_limits.min_module_lines")
484	TRUE_KEYS = ("tool.mypy.strict", "tool.pytest.ini_options.xfail_strict")
485	OFF_KEYS = ("tool.pylint.main.exit-zero",)  # turning one on silences a check
486	NO_SHRINK = ("tool.ruff.lint.select", "tool.ruff.lint.extend-select")
487	NO_GROW = (
488	    "tool.ruff.lint.ignore", "tool.ruff.lint.extend-ignore", "tool.ruff.exclude",
489	    "tool.ruff.extend-exclude", "tool.ruff.lint.exclude", "tool.deptry.exclude",
490	    "tool.deptry.extend_exclude", "tool.deptry.ignore", "tool.vulture.ignore_names",
491	    "tool.vulture.exclude", "tool.mypy.exclude", "tool.pylint.main.ignore-paths",
492	    "tool.pylint.main.ignore", "tool.pylint.main.ignore-patterns",
493	)  # fmt: skip
494	# Excluding the references or probes folder is not a loosening: neither is project code (CR-08).
495	OUTSIDE_EXCLUDE = re.compile(r"\^?(references|probes)/?\*{0,2}")
496	NO_GROW_TABLES = ("tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores", "tool.deptry.per_rule_ignores")
497	MUST_MATCH = ("tool.importlinter", "tool.mypy.overrides", "tool.pyright")
498	STRICT_FLAGS = ("--strict-markers", "--strict-config")
499	
500	
501	def _get(data: dict[str, Any], dotted: str) -> Any:
502	    for key in dotted.split("."):
503	        if not isinstance(data, dict) or key not in data:
504	            return None
505	        data = data[key]
506	    return data
507	
508	
509	def _as_set(value: Any) -> set[str]:
510	    if isinstance(value, str):
511	        return {value}
512	    return {str(v) for v in value} if isinstance(value, list) else set()
513	
514	
515	def _limit_findings(old: dict[str, Any], new: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
516	    pylint = _get(old, "tool.ruff.lint.pylint") or {}
517	    maxes = [*MAX_KEYS, *(f"tool.ruff.lint.pylint.{k}" for k in pylint)]
518	    out = [
519	        f"{k}: {_get(old, k)} -> {_get(new, k)}"
520	        for k in maxes
521	        if _loosened(_get(old, k), _get(new, k), +1)
522	    ]
523	    out += [
524	        f"{k}: {_get(old, k)} -> {_get(new, k)}"
525	        for k in MIN_KEYS
526	        if _loosened(_get(old, k), _get(new, k), -1)
527	    ]
528	    out += [
529	        f"{k} turned off" for k in TRUE_KEYS if _get(old, k) is True and _get(new, k) is not True
530	    ]
531	    out += [f"{k} turned on" for k in OFF_KEYS if _get(new, k) is True and _get(old, k) is not True]
532	    return out
533	
534	
535	def _loosened(was: Any, now: Any, direction: int) -> bool:
536	    if not isinstance(was, (int, float)):
537	        return False
538	    if not isinstance(now, (int, float)):
539	        return True  # a limit that disappeared
540	    return (now - was) * direction > 0
541	
542	
543	def _list_findings(old: dict[str, Any], new: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
544	    out = [f"{k} lost {sorted(_as_set(_get(old, k)) - _as_set(_get(new, k)))}" for k in NO_SHRINK]
545	    for k in NO_GROW:
546	        gained = _as_set(_get(new, k)) - _as_set(_get(old, k))
547	        out.append(f"{k} gained {sorted(g for g in gained if not OUTSIDE_EXCLUDE.fullmatch(g))}")
548	    for table in NO_GROW_TABLES:
549	        was, now = _get(old, table) or {}, _get(new, table) or {}
550	        out += [
551	            f"{table}.{key} gained {sorted(_as_set(codes) - _as_set(was.get(key)))}"
552	            for key, codes in now.items()
553	            if _as_set(codes) - _as_set(was.get(key))
554	        ]
555	    flags = _as_set((_get(new, "tool.pytest.ini_options.addopts") or "").split())
556	    out += [
557	        f"pytest addopts dropped {f}"
558	        for f in STRICT_FLAGS
559	        if f in str(_get(old, "tool.pytest.ini_options.addopts")) and f not in flags
560	    ]
561	    out += [
562	        f"{k} changed (boundaries and type config change only through build-setup)"
563	        for k in MUST_MATCH
564	        if _get(old, k) != _get(new, k)
565	    ]
566	    return [o for o in out if not o.endswith("[]")]
567	
568	
569	def config_findings(old_pyproject: Path, diff: Diff) -> list[Finding]:
570	    found = [
571	        Finding("bar-loosened", p, 0, "new tool config file overrides pyproject.toml")
572	        for p in diff.added
573	        if Path(p).name in CONFIG_FILES and not p.startswith("scripts/")
574	    ]
575	    old_text = old_pyproject.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if old_pyproject.is_file() else ""
576	    if not old_text or not Path("pyproject.toml").is_file():
577	        return found
578	    try:
579	        old, new = (
580	            tomllib.loads(old_text),
581	            tomllib.loads(Path("pyproject.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
582	        )
583	    except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as exc:
584	        return [*found, Finding("bar-loosened", "pyproject.toml", 0, f"cannot parse: {exc}")]
585	    changes = _limit_findings(old, new) + _list_findings(old, new)
586	    return found + [Finding("bar-loosened", "pyproject.toml", 0, c) for c in changes]
587	
588	
589	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- CONSTRAINTS.md
590	RULE_REF = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:-\s*\*\*(CR-\d+)\*\*|\|\s*(CR-\d+)\s*\|)")
591	
592	
593	def _section(lines: list[str], title: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
594	    """1-based line range of a `## title` section, or (0, -1)."""
595	    start = next((i for i, t in enumerate(lines, 1) if t.strip().lower() == f"## {title}"), 0)
596	    if not start:
597	        return 0, -1
598	    end = next(
599	        (i - 1 for i, t in enumerate(lines, 1) if i > start and t.startswith("## ")), len(lines)
600	    )
601	    return start, end
602	
603	
604	def _table_rows(lines: list[str], start: int, end: int) -> list[tuple[int, list[str]]]:
605	    rows = []
606	    for n in range(start + 1, end + 1):
607	        text = lines[n - 1].strip()
608	        if not text.startswith("|"):
609	            continue
610	        cells = [c.strip() for c in text.strip("|").split("|")]
611	        if cells and cells[0] not in {"", "ID"} and not set(cells[0]) <= set("-: "):
612	            rows.append((n, cells))
613	    return rows
614	
615	
616	def constraints_findings(diff: Diff) -> list[Finding]:
617	    path = "CONSTRAINTS.md"
618	    if path not in diff.added and path not in diff.removed:
619	        return []
620	    still = {
621	        m.group(1) or m.group(2) for _, t in diff.added.get(path, []) if (m := RULE_REF.match(t))
622	    }
623	    gone = {
624	        m.group(1) or m.group(2) for t in diff.removed.get(path, []) if (m := RULE_REF.match(t))
625	    }
626	    found = [Finding("rule-removed", path, 0, f"{rule} removed") for rule in sorted(gone - still)]
627	    lines = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if Path(path).is_file() else []
628	    start, end = _section(lines, "exceptions")
629	    new_rows = diff.added_lines(path)
630	    found += [
631	        Finding("new-exception", path, n, f"new exception {cells[0]} needs the user's yes")
632	        for n, cells in _table_rows(lines, start, end)
633	        if n in new_rows
634	    ]
635	    return found
636	
637	
638	def load_exceptions(today: date) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
639	    """(rule cell, path glob) for each unexpired row in CONSTRAINTS.md's Exceptions table."""
640	    path = Path("CONSTRAINTS.md")
641	    if not path.is_file():
642	        return []
643	    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
644	    allowed = []
645	    for _, cells in _table_rows(lines, *_section(lines, "exceptions")):
646	        if len(cells) < 6:
647	            continue
648	        expires = re.match(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", cells[5])
649	        if expires and date.fromisoformat(expires[0]) < today:
650	            continue
651	        allowed.append((cells[1], cells[2].strip("`")))
652	    return allowed
653	
654	
655	def is_excepted(finding: Finding, allowed: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> bool:
656	    rule_id = RULE_IDS.get(finding.rule)
657	    return bool(rule_id) and any(
658	        rule_id in rule and fnmatch.fnmatch(finding.path, glob) for rule, glob in allowed
659	    )
660	
661	
662	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- main
663	def run(
664	    diff: Diff, old_pyproject: Path, python_files: list[str] | None = None, at_exit: bool = False
665	) -> list[Finding]:
666	    found = line_findings(diff) + test_file_findings(diff)
667	    found += task_stub_findings(python_files or [], at_exit)
668	    for path in diff.added:
669	        if is_python(path):
670	            found += ast_findings(path, diff.added_lines(path))
671	    found += config_findings(old_pyproject, diff) + constraints_findings(diff)
672	    allowed = load_exceptions(datetime.now(tz=UTC).date())
673	    return [f for f in found if not is_excepted(f, allowed)]
674	
675	
676	def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
677	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
678	    parser.add_argument("--diff", type=Path, required=True)
679	    parser.add_argument("--untracked", type=Path, required=True)
680	    parser.add_argument("--old-pyproject", type=Path, required=True)
681	    parser.add_argument(
682	        "--python", type=Path, help="every Python file in the project, one per line"
683	    )
684	    parser.add_argument(
685	        "--exit", action="store_true", help="the milestone exit: no stub may be left"
686	    )
687	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
688	    diff = parse_diff(args.diff.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
689	    add_untracked(diff, args.untracked.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
690	    python_files = args.python.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if args.python else []
691	    findings = run(diff, args.old_pyproject, python_files, args.exit)
692	    if not findings:
693	        print("floor_guard: clean", file=sys.stderr)
694	        return 0
695	    print("\n".join(str(f) for f in sorted(findings)))
696	    print(
697	        f"floor_guard: {len(findings)} floor violation(s). Fix the code; a real exception goes "
698	        "through build-setup (Revise) and the Exceptions table in CONSTRAINTS.md.",
699	        file=sys.stderr,
700	    )
701	    return 1
702	
703	
704	if __name__ == "__main__":
705	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1	# rllab — Tests
2	
3	**Package:** rllab · **Status:** Approved · **Last updated:** 2026-10-17 · **Pipelines:** [pipelines.md](pipelines.md)
4	
5	Board coordinates are `(row, col)` with row 0 at the top, so "up" decreases the row. Bodies are listed head first. Boards are set with `Snake.reset_to`. Snake and corridor cases address agent 0 of a batch of one (AD-09): an action list is one action per step, and an expected observation is agent 0's row.
6	
7	Tank positions are `(x, y)` in tank radii with the centre at the origin, set with `FishTank.reset_to`. The ball reflects when its edge reaches the wall, that is, when its centre is 0.92 from the origin. Predator-prey positions use the same frame, set with `PredatorPrey.reset_to`; each case's `input.json` lists all 6 prey; unless a case says otherwise, the other prey sit at `(−0.5, 0)`, `(0, 0.5)`, `(0, −0.5)`, `(−0.4, 0.4)`, `(−0.4, −0.4)` and the 8 pellets on the circle of radius 0.9 at 45° steps from `(0.9, 0)`, every animal at rest.
8

"""The core's data types: teams, actions, steps, transitions and run settings (AD-09, AD-13)."""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal

import numpy as np

SOLO: str = "agents"
"""The one team name every single-team environment uses."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActionSpace:
    """Discrete: `n >= 2` and `dim == 0`. Continuous: `dim >= 1` and `n == 0`."""

    kind: Literal["discrete", "continuous"]
    n: int = 0
    dim: int = 0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TeamSpec:
    """One team's size, per-agent observation shape and shared action space."""

    n_agents: int
    obs_shape: tuple[int, ...]
    actions: ActionSpace


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StepResult:
    """One environment step, each map keyed by team and batch-first over that team's agents."""

    obs: dict[str, np.ndarray]
    reward: dict[str, np.ndarray]
    done: dict[str, np.ndarray]
    terminated: bool
    truncated: bool
    info: dict[str, float]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Transition:
    """One learning team's step, batch-first; `terminated` is never set by truncation."""

    obs: np.ndarray
    actions: np.ndarray
    reward: np.ndarray
    next_obs: np.ndarray
    terminated: np.ndarray
    active: np.ndarray
    truncated: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rewards:
    """Reward sizes; for the corridor `food` is the goal reward."""

    food: float = 1.0
    death: float = -1.0
    step: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Exploration:
    """A rate falling linearly from `start` to `end` over `decay_steps`, then constant."""

    start: float = 1.0
    end: float = 0.05
    decay_steps: int = 50_000


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentParams:
    """Learner hyperparameters; each agent reads the fields it uses."""

    lr: float
    gamma: float
    batch_size: int = 64
    memory_size: int = 50_000
    target_every: int = 1_000
    learn_start: int = 1_000
    hidden: int = 128
    net: Literal["mlp", "cnn"] = "mlp"
    rollout_steps: int = 2048
    epochs: int = 10
    clip: float = 0.2
    gae_lambda: float = 0.95
    games_per_update: int = 10


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunSettings:
    """Everything one run needs, fully resolved (RUN-01)."""

    name: str
    env: Literal["snake", "corridor", "tank", "predprey"]
    view: Literal["compact", "grid", "index", "full", "limited"]
    agent: Literal["tabular", "dqn", "reinforce", "ppo", "random", "scripted", "reference"]
    n_agents: int
    opponents: Mapping[str, Literal["learn", "scripted", "random"]]
    self_play: Literal["none", "latest", "pool"]
    pool_latest: float
    generations: int
    ablation: Literal["none", "no_memory", "no_target", "no_explore"]
    rewards: Rewards
    exploration: Exploration
    params: AgentParams
    steps: int
    seed: int
    eval_every: int
    eval_games: int

"""The two interfaces every environment and every player implements (AD-03, AD-09, AD-13)."""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal, Protocol

import numpy as np

from rllab.core.types import StepResult, TeamSpec, Transition


class Env(Protocol):
    """A game over teams of agents, each team batch-first."""

    teams: Mapping[str, TeamSpec]
    board: Literal["grid", "tank"]

    def reset(self, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]: ...

    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult: ...

    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray: ...


class Agent(Protocol):
    """A player acting for one team: one action per agent of the batch."""

    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray: ...

    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None: ...

    def save(self, path: Path) -> None: ...

    def load(self, path: Path) -> None: ...

"""Snake on a square grid, one agent, compact or grid view (SNAKE-01 to SNAKE-09)."""

from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from typing import Literal

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import Env, Rewards, StepResult


class Snake(Env):
    """One team, `SOLO`, of one snake; actions 0 straight, 1 turn left, 2 turn right."""

    board: Literal["grid", "tank"] = "grid"

    def __init__(
        self,

        rewards: Rewards = Rewards(),

        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T13")

        """Start a game from a given board: cells `(row, col)`, body head first."""
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T13")

    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T13")

    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T13")

"""The table-based value learner (AGENT-01, AGENT-02, ABL-03)."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import Agent, AgentParams, Exploration, Transition


class TabularAgent(Agent):
    """One value per (observation bytes, action), starting at 0; batches of one agent."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        n_actions: int,
        params: AgentParams,
        exploration: Exploration,
        *,
        seed: int,
        explore_enabled: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T15")

    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T15")

    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T15")

    def save(self, path: Path) -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T15")

"""What a run folder holds: its curve, its recorded games and the run itself (AD-06)."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import RunSettings


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurvePoint:
    """One greedy evaluation during training; `step` strictly increases within a run."""

    step: int
    games: int
    mean_score: float
    elapsed_s: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GameRecording:
    """One game's frames (start plus one per step), per-step total rewards and team scores."""

    seed: int
    board: Literal["grid", "tank"]
    frames: np.ndarray
    rewards: np.ndarray
    scores: dict[str, np.ndarray]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RunRecord:
    """A run folder read back: settings, curve, status, checkpoints, generations and games."""

    path: Path
    settings: RunSettings
    curve: tuple[CurvePoint, ...]
    status: Literal["running", "complete", "incomplete"]
    checkpoints: dict[str, Path]
    generations: dict[str, tuple[Path, ...]]
    games: tuple[GameRecording, ...]

        raise NotImplementedError("M1-T03")


def create_run(settings: RunSettings, *, root: Path = Path("runs")) -> RunWriter:

    raise NotImplementedError("M1-T03")

    """Read a run folder back (PL-05 step 1)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("M1-T03")

"""What one evaluation asks for and what it returns."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

from rllab.core import SOLO
from rllab.runs import GameRecording


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EvalSpec:
    """`n_games` games of `team` on `eval_seeds(train_seed, n_games)`, the first `record` recorded."""

    player: str
    train_seed: int
    team: str = SOLO
    n_games: int = 200
    record: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.n_games < 1:

"""What a report names: its players, baselines and chart groups (PL-04)."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from rllab.runs import RunRecord


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlayerTarget:
    """One report player: `targets[i]` (a run folder or a baseline name) scored on `seeds[i]`."""

    name: str
    targets: tuple[str, ...]
    seeds: tuple[int, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReportTargets:
    """The players to score, the baselines drawn as lines, and each chart's player names.

    `ablations` maps each ablation player to its full agent's player.
    """

    players: tuple[PlayerTarget, ...]
    baselines: tuple[str, ...]
    ladder: tuple[str, ...]
    ablations: dict[str, str]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurveRuns:
    """Each chart's groups: player name to its runs, one per training seed."""

    ladder: dict[str, tuple[RunRecord, ...]]
    ablations: dict[str, tuple[RunRecord, ...]]

"""The command line: `python -m rllab.lab <train | eval | replay | report> ...`."""

import argparse
import os
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from rllab.core import load_settings
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl01_train import run_train
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl02_train_reference import run_train_reference
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl03_evaluate import run_evaluate
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl04_report import run_report
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl05_replay import run_replay


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Run one subcommand; 0 on success, 2 on bad settings or a missing run."""
    args = _parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.smoke:
        os.environ["MPLBACKEND"] = "Agg"  # headless: charts are written, no window opens
    try:
        args.command(args)
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


def _train(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """PL-01 per seed, or PL-02 when the settings name the reference agent."""
    path = Path(args.settings)
    settings = load_settings(path)
    entry = run_train_reference if settings.agent == "reference" else run_train
    for seed in seed_range(args.seeds, default=settings.seed):
        entry(path, seed)


def _eval(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    for target in args.targets:
        run_evaluate(target, args.seed)


def _replay(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    if args.new and args.seed is None:
        raise ValueError("--new needs --seed S")
    run_replay(Path(args.run), game=args.game, new_seed=args.seed if args.new else None)


def _report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    spec = Path(args.spec)
    run_report(spec, out=spec.parent)


def seed_range(text: str | None, *, default: int) -> list[int]:
    """`"0-4"` is seeds 0 to 4, `"3"` is seed 3, and no text is `default`."""
    if text is None:
        return [default]
    first, _, last = text.partition("-")
    seeds = list(range(int(first), int(last or first) + 1))
    if not seeds:
        raise ValueError(f"--seeds {text!r} names no seed")
    return seeds


def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    common.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true", help="headless smoke run")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m rllab.lab")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(required=True)

    train = commands.add_parser("train", parents=[common], help="train one run per seed")
    train.add_argument("settings", help="settings TOML file")
    train.add_argument("--seeds", help="seeds, such as 0-4 (default: the settings' seed)")
    train.set_defaults(command=_train)

    evaluate = commands.add_parser("eval", parents=[common], help="score players")
    evaluate.add_argument("targets", nargs="+", help="run folders, random or scripted")
    evaluate.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0, help="training seed to score on")
    evaluate.set_defaults(command=_eval)

    replay = commands.add_parser("replay", parents=[common], help="replay a recorded game")
    replay.add_argument("run", help="run folder")
    which = replay.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    which.add_argument("--game", type=int, default=0, help="recorded game index")
    which.add_argument("--new", action="store_true", help="play a new game on --seed")
    replay.add_argument("--seed", type=int, help="seed of the new game")
    replay.set_defaults(command=_replay)

    report = commands.add_parser("report", parents=[common], help="test claims, draw charts")
    report.add_argument("spec", help="report TOML file; outputs go beside it")
    report.set_defaults(command=_report)
    return parser
