"""runs.RunWriter: the in-memory double writes the recorded 3-point run and finishes it."""

from rllab.core import SOLO
from rllab.runs import RunWriter

SYMBOL = "runs.RunWriter"


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


def test_double_passes_the_writer_check(codec, tmp_path):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    agents = codec.fake("core.Agent")
    run = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "corridor_3_points", fake.WriterRun)
    recording = codec.sample("core.Agent", "tabular_corridor_5", agents.AgentRecording)
    record = fake.check_writer(fake.MemoryRunWriter(tmp_path, run.settings), run, agents.ReplayAgent(recording))
    assert len(record.curve) == 3
    assert record.checkpoints[SOLO].is_file()


def test_double_saves_numbered_generations(codec, tmp_path):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    agents = codec.fake("core.Agent")
    run = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "corridor_3_points", fake.WriterRun)
    agent = agents.ReplayAgent(codec.sample("core.Agent", "tabular_corridor_5", agents.AgentRecording))
    writer = fake.MemoryRunWriter(tmp_path, run.settings)
    paths = [writer.save_generation(agent, team="prey", index=i) for i in range(3)]
    assert paths == [tmp_path / "generations" / "prey" / str(i) for i in range(3)]
    assert writer.finish("incomplete").generations == {"prey": tuple(paths)}


def test_writer_has_the_contract_methods():
    assert {"add_point", "save_checkpoint", "save_generation", "save_games", "finish"} <= set(dir(RunWriter))

"""runs.open_run: the fake reads a run folder back and names a run missing its settings."""

from rllab.runs import RunRecord

SYMBOL = "runs.open_run"


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


def test_fake_passes_the_open_run_check(codec, tmp_path):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    record = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "complete_corridor", RunRecord)
    run = tmp_path / record.path.name
    run.mkdir()
    (run / "settings.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    missing = tmp_path / "corridor-tabular-s9-no-settings"
    missing.mkdir()
    fake.check_open_run(fake.make_open_run(record), run, missing)


def test_fake_serves_the_sample(codec, tmp_path):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    record = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "complete_corridor", RunRecord)
    (tmp_path / "settings.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    opened = fake.make_open_run(record)(tmp_path)
    assert opened.status == "complete"
    assert opened.curve == record.curve

"""evaluate.evaluate: the fake serves the scripted-player ScoreSet and passes the check."""

from typing import Any

import pytest

from rllab.core import SOLO
from rllab.evaluate import EvalSpec

SYMBOL = "evaluate.evaluate"


def _setup(codec):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    sample = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "scripted_seed0", dict[str, Any])
    scores = codec.build(fake.ScoreSet, sample["scores"])
    game = codec.build(fake.GameRecording, sample["game"])
    envs, agents = codec.fake("core.Env"), codec.fake("core.Agent")
    env_recording = codec.sample("core.Env", "snake_wall_20", envs.EnvRecording)
    agent = agents.ReplayAgent(codec.sample("agents.DQNAgent", "compact_5_after_learn_start", agents.AgentRecording))
    return fake.make_evaluate(scores, game), (lambda: envs.ReplayEnv(env_recording)), {SOLO: agent}, fake


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("n_games", "record"), [(200, 0), (1, 1), (50, 5)])
def test_fake_passes_the_evaluate_check(codec, n_games, record):
    evaluate, make_env, agents, fake = _setup(codec)
    spec = EvalSpec(player="scripted", train_seed=0, n_games=n_games, record=record)
    fake.check_evaluate(evaluate, make_env, agents, spec)
    assert not agents[SOLO].learned


def test_fake_echoes_the_sample_scores(codec):
    evaluate, make_env, agents, _ = _setup(codec)
    sample = codec.sample("evaluate.ScoreSet", "scripted_seed0", _setup(codec)[3].ScoreSet)
    result = evaluate(make_env, agents, EvalSpec(player="scripted", train_seed=0))
    assert result.scores.tolist() == sample.scores.tolist()

"""evaluate.evaluate: the fake serves the scripted-player ScoreSet and passes the check."""

import pytest

from rllab.core import SOLO
from rllab.evaluate import EvalSpec, ScoreSet
from rllab.runs import GameRecording

SYMBOL = "evaluate.evaluate"


def _fake_evaluate(codec):
    raw = codec.samples(SYMBOL)["scripted_seed0"]
    scores = codec.build(ScoreSet, raw["scores"])
    game = codec.build(GameRecording, raw["game"])
    return codec.fake(SYMBOL).make_evaluate(scores, game), scores


def _players(codec):
    envs, agents = codec.fake("core.Env"), codec.fake("core.Agent")
    env_recording = codec.sample("core.Env", "snake_wall_20", envs.EnvRecording)
    agent_recording = codec.sample(
        "agents.DQNAgent", "compact_5_after_learn_start", agents.AgentRecording
    )
    return (lambda: envs.ReplayEnv(env_recording)), {SOLO: agents.ReplayAgent(agent_recording)}


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("n_games", "record"), [(200, 0), (1, 1), (50, 5)])
def test_fake_passes_the_evaluate_check(codec, n_games, record):
    evaluate, _ = _fake_evaluate(codec)
    make_env, agents = _players(codec)
    spec = EvalSpec(player="scripted", train_seed=0, n_games=n_games, record=record)
    codec.fake(SYMBOL).check_evaluate(evaluate, make_env, agents, spec)
    assert not agents[SOLO].learned


def test_fake_echoes_the_sample_scores(codec):
    evaluate, scores = _fake_evaluate(codec)
    make_env, agents = _players(codec)
    result = evaluate(make_env, agents, EvalSpec(player="scripted", train_seed=0))
    assert result.scores.tolist() == scores.scores.tolist()

"""compare.run_claims: the fake returns one passed and one failed Claim and passes the check."""

from dataclasses import replace

from rllab.compare import Claim, ClaimSpec
from rllab.evaluate import ScoreSet

SYMBOL = "compare.run_claims"


def _scores(codec, names):
    base = codec.sample("evaluate.ScoreSet", "scripted_seed0", ScoreSet)
    return {name: (replace(base, player=name),) for name in names}


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


def test_fake_passes_the_run_claims_check(codec, tmp_path):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    claims = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "one_passed_one_failed", tuple[Claim, ...])
    specs = [codec.sample("compare.ClaimSpec", case, ClaimSpec) for case in codec.samples("compare.ClaimSpec")]
    scores = _scores(codec, {name for spec in specs for name in (spec.a, spec.b)})
    results = fake.check_run_claims(fake.make_run_claims(claims), scores, specs, tmp_path)
    assert [claim.passed for claim in results[:2]] == [True, False]

"""viz.Replay: the windowless double advances a 12-frame game to its end and stops."""

from rllab.runs import GameRecording
from rllab.viz import Replay

SYMBOL = "viz.Replay"


def test_samples_follow_the_schema(codec):
    codec.assert_samples_valid(SYMBOL)


def test_double_passes_the_replay_check(codec):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    game = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "snake_12_frames", GameRecording)
    assert game.frames.shape[0] == 12
    fake.check_replay(fake.ReplayDouble(game), game)


def test_double_show_plays_to_the_last_frame(codec):
    fake = codec.fake(SYMBOL)
    game = codec.sample(SYMBOL, "snake_12_frames", GameRecording)
    replay = fake.ReplayDouble(game, fps=16.0)
    replay.show()
    assert replay.index == 11


def test_replay_has_the_contract_methods():
    assert {"advance", "show"} <= set(dir(Replay))

"""The M1 interface: each component exports its contract, and every step, contract function
and entry function has its frozen signature (checked by signature, never by calling it)."""

import importlib
import inspect
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal, Protocol

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.agents import DQNAgent, TabularAgent
from rllab.baselines import RandomPlayer, ScriptedPlayer
from rllab.compare import Claim, ClaimSpec, run_claims
from rllab.core import (
    SOLO,
    Agent,
    AgentParams,
    Env,
    Exploration,
    Rewards,
    RunSettings,
    StepResult,
    TeamSpec,
    Transition,
    load_settings,
)
from rllab.core.settings import with_seed
from rllab.envs import Corridor, Snake
from rllab.evaluate import EvalSpec, ScoreSet, eval_seeds, evaluate
from rllab.lab import main
from rllab.lab.build import make_agent, make_env
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl01_train import run_train
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl02_train_reference import run_train_reference
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl03_evaluate import run_evaluate
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl04_report import run_report
from rllab.lab.pipelines.pl05_replay import run_replay
from rllab.lab.players import load_player, open_curve_runs, score_players
from rllab.lab.printing import print_scores
from rllab.lab.replay import pick_game
from rllab.lab.report_spec import load_report_spec
from rllab.lab.types import CurveRuns, ReportTargets
from rllab.reference import ReferencePlayer, train_reference
from rllab.runs import CurvePoint, GameRecording, RunRecord, RunWriter, create_run, open_run
from rllab.train import train
from rllab.viz import Chart, Replay, plot_curves

EXPORTS = {
    "rllab.core": [
        "SOLO",
        "ActionSpace",
        "Agent",
        "AgentParams",
        "Env",
        "Exploration",
        "Rewards",
        "RunSettings",
        "StepResult",
        "TeamSpec",
        "Transition",
        "load_settings",
    ],
    "rllab.envs": ["COMPACT_FIELDS", "Corridor", "Snake"],
    "rllab.baselines": ["RandomPlayer", "ScriptedPlayer"],
    "rllab.agents": ["DQNAgent", "TabularAgent"],
    "rllab.runs": ["CurvePoint", "GameRecording", "RunRecord", "RunWriter", "create_run", "open_run"],
    "rllab.evaluate": ["EvalSpec", "ScoreSet", "eval_seeds", "evaluate"],
    "rllab.train": ["train"],
    "rllab.reference": ["ReferencePlayer", "train_reference"],
    "rllab.compare": ["Claim", "ClaimSpec", "run_claims"],
    "rllab.viz": ["Chart", "Replay", "plot_curves"],
    "rllab.lab": ["main"],
}


class Steps(Protocol):
    """Each method's signature, minus `self`, is the frozen one of the same-named function."""

    def load_settings(self, path: Path) -> RunSettings: ...
    def with_seed(self, settings: RunSettings, seed: int) -> RunSettings: ...
    def make_env(self, settings: RunSettings) -> Callable[[], Env]: ...
    def make_agent(self, settings: RunSettings, env: Env) -> dict[str, Agent]: ...
    def create_run(self, settings: RunSettings, *, root: Path = Path("runs")) -> RunWriter: ...
    def open_run(self, path: Path) -> RunRecord: ...
    def eval_seeds(self, train_seed: int, n: int) -> list[int]: ...
    def evaluate(
        self, make_env: Callable[[], Env], agents: Mapping[str, Agent], spec: EvalSpec
    ) -> ScoreSet: ...
    def train(
        self,
        make_env: Callable[[], Env],
        agents: Mapping[str, Agent],
        settings: RunSettings,
        *,
        root: Path = Path("runs"),
    ) -> RunRecord: ...
    def train_reference(
        self, settings: RunSettings, *, root: Path = Path("runs")
    ) -> RunRecord: ...
    def run_claims(
        self,
        scores: Mapping[str, Sequence[ScoreSet]],
        specs: Sequence[ClaimSpec],
        *,
        alpha: float = 0.05,
        charts: Sequence[Chart] = (),
        out: Path,
    ) -> list[Claim]: ...
    def plot_curves(
        self,
        groups: Mapping[str, Sequence[RunRecord]],
        *,
        scores: Mapping[str, Sequence[ScoreSet]],
        baselines: Sequence[str],
        out: Path,
    ) -> Chart: ...
    def load_player(self, target: str, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, Agent], RunSettings]: ...
    def score_players(self, targets: ReportTargets) -> dict[str, tuple[ScoreSet, ...]]: ...
    def open_curve_runs(self, targets: ReportTargets) -> CurveRuns: ...
    def load_report_spec(self, path: Path) -> tuple[tuple[ClaimSpec, ...], ReportTargets]: ...
    def pick_game(self, record: RunRecord, game: int, new_seed: int | None) -> GameRecording: ...
    def print_scores(self, scores: ScoreSet) -> ScoreSet: ...
    def run_train(self, settings_path: Path, seed: int) -> RunRecord: ...
    def run_train_reference(self, settings_path: Path, seed: int) -> RunRecord: ...
    def run_evaluate(self, target: str, seed: int) -> ScoreSet: ...
    def run_report(self, spec_path: Path, out: Path) -> list[Claim]: ...
    def run_replay(self, run: Path, game: int = 0, new_seed: int | None = None) -> None: ...
    def main(self, argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int: ...


FUNCTIONS = [
    load_settings,
    with_seed,
    make_env,
    make_agent,
    create_run,
    open_run,
    eval_seeds,
    evaluate,
    train,
    train_reference,
    run_claims,
    plot_curves,
    load_player,
    score_players,
    open_curve_runs,
    load_report_spec,
    pick_game,
    print_scores,
    run_train,
    run_train_reference,
    run_evaluate,
    run_report,
    run_replay,
    main,
]


class SnakeInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(
        self, *, view: Literal["compact", "grid"], rewards: Rewards = Rewards(), size: int = 10
    ) -> None: ...
    def reset_to(
        self,
        body: Sequence[tuple[int, int]],
        heading: Literal["up", "right", "down", "left"],
        food: tuple[int, int],
    ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, int]]: ...


class CorridorInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(
        self, *, length: int = 10, max_steps: int = 50, rewards: Rewards = Rewards()
    ) -> None: ...


class TabularInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(
        self,
        n_actions: int,
        params: AgentParams,
        exploration: Exploration,
        *,
        seed: int,
        explore_enabled: bool = True,
    ) -> None: ...


class DQNInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(
        self,
        team: TeamSpec,
        params: AgentParams,
        exploration: Exploration,
        *,
        seed: int,
        ablation: Literal["none", "no_memory", "no_target"] = "none",
    ) -> None: ...


class RandomInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(self, n_actions: int, *, seed: int) -> None: ...


class NoArgInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(self) -> None: ...


class ReferenceInit(Protocol):
    def __init__(self, checkpoint: Path) -> None: ...


class ReplayContract(Protocol):
    def __init__(self, game: GameRecording, *, fps: float = 8.0) -> None: ...
    def advance(self) -> int: ...
    def show(self) -> None: ...


class WriterContract(Protocol):
    def add_point(self, p: CurvePoint) -> None: ...
    def save_checkpoint(self, agent: Agent, *, team: str = SOLO) -> None: ...
    def save_generation(self, agent: Agent, *, team: str, index: int) -> Path: ...
    def save_games(self, games: Sequence[GameRecording]) -> None: ...
    def finish(self, status: Literal["complete", "incomplete"]) -> RunRecord: ...


class EnvMethods(Protocol):
    def reset(self, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]: ...
    def step(self, actions: Mapping[str, np.ndarray]) -> StepResult: ...
    def frame(self) -> np.ndarray: ...


class AgentMethods(Protocol):
    def act(self, obs: np.ndarray, *, explore: bool) -> np.ndarray: ...
    def learn(self, t: Transition) -> None: ...
    def save(self, path: Path) -> None: ...
    def load(self, path: Path) -> None: ...


METHODS = [
    (Snake, SnakeInit, ["__init__", "reset_to"]),
    (Corridor, CorridorInit, ["__init__"]),
    (TabularAgent, TabularInit, ["__init__"]),
    (DQNAgent, DQNInit, ["__init__"]),
    (RandomPlayer, RandomInit, ["__init__"]),
    (ScriptedPlayer, NoArgInit, ["__init__"]),
    (ReferencePlayer, ReferenceInit, ["__init__"]),
    (Replay, ReplayContract, ["__init__", "advance", "show"]),
    (RunWriter, WriterContract, ["add_point", "save_checkpoint", "save_generation", "save_games", "finish"]),
    (Env, EnvMethods, ["reset", "step", "frame"]),
    (Agent, AgentMethods, ["act", "learn", "save", "load"]),
    *((env, EnvMethods, ["reset", "step", "frame"]) for env in (Snake, Corridor)),
    *(
        (agent, AgentMethods, ["act", "learn", "save", "load"])
        for agent in (TabularAgent, DQNAgent, RandomPlayer, ScriptedPlayer, ReferencePlayer)
    ),
]


def _without_self(function: Callable[..., object]) -> inspect.Signature:
    signature = inspect.signature(function)
    return signature.replace(parameters=list(signature.parameters.values())[1:])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("module", sorted(EXPORTS))
def test_component_exports_only_its_contract(module):
    assert sorted(importlib.import_module(module).__all__) == sorted(EXPORTS[module])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("function", FUNCTIONS, ids=lambda f: f.__name__)
def test_function_has_its_frozen_signature(function):
    assert inspect.signature(function) == _without_self(getattr(Steps, function.__name__))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("cls", "contract", "name"),
    [(cls, contract, name) for cls, contract, names in METHODS for name in names],
    ids=lambda value: getattr(value, "__name__", str(value)),
)
def test_method_has_its_frozen_signature(cls, contract, name):
    assert _without_self(getattr(cls, name)) == _without_self(getattr(contract, name))


def test_lab_types_have_their_fields():
    assert list(ReportTargets.__dataclass_fields__) == ["players", "baselines", "ladder", "ablations"]
    assert list(CurveRuns.__dataclass_fields__) == ["ladder", "ablations"]
